n: Freenove Robot Dog Kit for Raspberry Pi
t: A four-legged robot dog kit you build, powered by a Raspberry Pi.
steps: Buy the kit from the Freenove Store. Get a Raspberry Pi, a microSD card, two high-drain 18650 cells, and a charger too.
Flash Raspberry Pi OS onto the microSD card with Raspberry Pi Imager.
Download the Freenove code from GitHub and install the Python libraries from the tutorial.
Build the dog by following the assembly chapter. Set aside an afternoon.
Run the module test for the servos, camera, sensors, and lights.
Calibrate each leg with the printed calibration sheet and the support pieces.
Start the server on the Pi and try the walking examples from the PC client or phone app.
Try the red ball tracing example next.
